title: How to Troubleshoot and Resolve a Slow Computer
solutionMarkdown:
. Step-by-Step Resolution

Step 1: Restart Your Computer

Save all open documents and files.

Close running applications.

Open the Windows Start menu.

Select Power.

Click Restart.

Wait for the system to restart completely.

Check whether system performance improves.

Step 2: Check Task Manager

Press Ctrl + Shift + Esc.

Open Task Manager.

Select the Processes tab.

Review CPU, Memory, and Disk usage.

Identify applications consuming unusually high resources.

Close applications that are unnecessary and safe to terminate.

Important: Do not terminate unknown Windows system processes.

Step 3: Disable Unnecessary Startup Applications

Open Task Manager.

Select Startup apps.

Review applications enabled during startup.

Identify applications that are not required immediately after login.
author: Prem Rachawar
